name: domjet-workspace

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @domjet/browser-protocol run build && pnpm --filter @domjet/browser-storage run build && pnpm --filter @domjet/browser-runtime run build && pnpm --filter domjet run build
scripts.test: pnpm --filter domjet run test && pnpm --filter @domjet/browser-runtime run test && pnpm --filter @domjet/browser-storage run test && pnpm --filter @domjet/browser-protocol run test

description: Domjet: a lightweight embedded browser SDK for Node.js.
